## Download

| Your computer | Download |
|---|---|
| **Mac** — macOS 11 Big Sur or later, Apple Silicon (M1–M4) or Intel | `ShareLocal_…_universal.dmg` |
| **Windows 10 / 11, 64-bit** — almost every PC | `ShareLocal_…_x64-setup.exe` |
| **Windows 10, 32-bit** — only older PCs | `ShareLocal_…_x86-setup.exe` |

Not sure which Windows you have? Open **Settings → System → About** and look at
*System type*: "64-bit operating system" means **x64**. If in doubt, take x64.

## First launch

ShareLocal is not signed with a paid Apple or Microsoft certificate yet, so
both systems ask once before opening it.

**Windows** — if you see *"Windows protected your PC"*, click **More info →
Run anyway**. When Windows asks about the firewall, allow **Private networks**,
or other devices will not find this one.

**macOS** — open the .dmg and drag ShareLocal into Applications. Open it once;
when macOS says it *could not verify* ShareLocal, go to **System Settings →
Privacy & Security**, scroll down, and click **Open Anyway**.

## System requirements

- **macOS 11 Big Sur or later.** The window is drawn by Safari's engine and
  needs Safari 16.4 or newer — every Mac on macOS 11+ gets it through Software
  Update.
- **Windows 10 or 11.** Uses Microsoft Edge WebView2, which Windows 10/11
  already include; the installer adds it if it is missing. Windows 7 and 8 are
  not supported.
- Phones need nothing installed — any current Safari, Chrome, Firefox or Edge.
